  exact Nat.card_eq_of_bijective e (Equiv.bijective e)

The goal is to show that the cardinality of the image of two isomorphic objects under a functor to `FintypeCat` is equal. Since `FintypeCat` is the category of finite types, the objects in this category are finite sets, and the cardinality of these sets is well-defined.

Given an isomorphism `i : X ≅ Y`, we want to show that the cardinality of `F.obj X` equals the cardinality of `F.obj Y`.

This can be done by using the fact that isomorphisms in a category preserve all categorical structure, including the underlying sets (in the case of concrete categories like `FintypeCat`). In particular, since `F` maps to `FintypeCat`, it must map objects to finite sets, and isomorphisms in the domain category induce isomorphisms between these sets. Thus, the cardinality of the images must be equal.

We will use the `Nat.subtype_card` lemma to compute the cardinality of the set `F.obj X`. But since `F.obj X` is a finite type, its cardinality is just the number of elements in the set, which is preserved under isomorphism.
